en: An old black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square with a large three‑story stone building identified as the Rathaus (town hall). It has symmetrical windows, a central pediment, and a small cupola with a clock and weather vane on the roof. In front is a monument with a bust (the Keller-Denkmal), steps, and a low balustrade. Cobblestone streets and smaller surrounding houses with a few pedestrians and carriages suggest an early 20th‑century European town scene. Red printed German text appears at the upper right.
